```{r the helper functions}
runAbTiterModel = function(pctParent, popCounts, weights, design, family = "gaussian", includeSex = T, cutOff = 10) {
  #'@title runModel
  #'@description This function runs a linear model on the CyTOF data. It uses the pctParent, popCounts, weights and design data to fit a linear model using age, sex, and studyGroup as covariates. The function returns a list of models. Fits are only returned for subsets where the median count of at least on study group is greater than the cutOff.
  #'@param pctParent Matrix of percent parent data, with rows corresponding to subsets and columns corresponding to samples.
  #'@param popCounts Matrix of population counts, with rows corresponding to subsets and columns corresponding to samples.
  #'@param weights Matrix of weights (parent counts), with rows corresponding to subsets and columns corresponding to samples.
  #'@param design Table with meta data
  #'@param family Modeling family
  #'@param cutOff Optional (default = 10), minimum median count for a subset to be included in the analysis
  #'@return A list of fits.
  
  models = list()
    
  message("Running linear model using ", family, " response for AbTiter at T3 for ", nrow(pctParent), " subsets")
  
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(pctParent), style = 3)
  i = 0
  
  zeroCounts = c()
  
  for (subset_ in row.names(pctParent)) {
    # update the progress bar
    i = i + 1
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
    
    data = data.frame(ALId = colnames(pctParent),
                      pctParent = as.numeric(pctParent[subset_,]),
                      count = as.numeric(popCounts[subset_,]),
                      weights = as.numeric(weights[subset_,])
    )
    
    data = merge(data, design, by.x = "ALId", by.y = "ALId")
    # summarize data, get median for count by studygroup
    medianCount = data %>%
      group_by(studyGroup) %>%
      summarize(medianCount = median(count))
    
    if (!any(medianCount$medianCount >= cutOff)) {
      zeroCounts = c(zeroCounts, subset_)
      next
    }
    
    if (length( unique(data$pctParent[!is.na(data$pctParent)]) ) <= 1) {
      zeroCounts = c(zeroCounts, subset_)
      next
    }
    
    if (family == "gaussian") {
      data$weights[data$weights == 0] = 1e-10
      
      # if (includeSex) {
      #   fit = glm(pctParent ~ studyGroup*sex*ageAtDraw, data = data, weights = data$weights)
      # } else {
        fit = glm(abTiter_T3 ~ studyGroup * pctParent, data = data, weights = data$weights)
      # }
      
    } else if (family == "binomial") {
      
      # # have to think about the weights - with a binomial model, they have to be integers (correspond to the "number of trials")
      # data$weights = round(data$weights)
      # data$weights = as.integer(data$weights)
      # 
      # data$pctParent = data$pctParent/100
      # fit = glm(pctParent ~ studyGroup*sex*ageAtDraw, data = data, weights = data$weights, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
    } else if (family == "beta") {
      # need to implement beta
      # this might help with including that + random effect even maybe?
      # https://www.reddit.com/r/rstats/comments/16azcem/family_choice_for_glm_with_01_dependent_variable/
    }
    
    models[[subset_]] = fit
    
  }
  # close the progress bar
  close(pb)
  
  return(models)
}

testVaxResponse <- function(models, subsets, design, pctParent, popCounts, weights) {
  # If there were no models, bail out immediately
  if (length(models) == 0) {
    message("No models to test; returning empty stats.")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  # Message
  message("Testing for effects of vax response in ", length(models), " subsets")

  # Initialize
  stats <- NULL
  pb    <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(models), style = 3)
  i = 0
  emm_options("msg.interaction" = FALSE)
  AICs = c()
  for (subset_ in names(models)) {
    i = i + 1
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
    
    # try to run model, if it fails, add an empty line for stats
    tryCatch({
        trends <- emtrends(models[[subset_]], 
                           ~ studyGroup, 
                           var = "pctParent")
    
      trends = test(trends)
      
      trends$subset = subset_
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      print(subset_)
      trends = data.frame(subset = subset_)
    })
    
    stats = rbind(stats, trends)
    
    AICs = c(AICs, AIC(models[[subset_]]))
  
    
  }
  # close the progress bar
  close(pb)
  
  emm_options("msg.interaction" = TRUE)
  
  names(AICs) = names(models)
  stats = merge(stats, subsets, by = "subset")
  
  
  stats$comparison = paste0(stats$studyGroup, " ab Titer effect")
  comparisons = unique(stats$comparison)
  
  
  message("Calculating summary statistics")
  summaryStats = c()
  
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(comparisons), style = 3)
  i = 0
  
  summaryStats = c()
  for (comparison_ in comparisons) {
    stats_ = stats %>% 
      dplyr::filter(comparison == comparison_) %>%
      dplyr::select(comparison, subset, studyGroup)
    
    studyGroup_ = unique(stats_$studyGroup)
    
    study_samples = dplyr::filter(design, studyGroup == studyGroup_)$ALId
    
    counts_study = popCounts[stats_$subset , study_samples]
    pctParent_study = pctParent[stats_$subset, study_samples]
    weights_study = weights[stats_$subset, study_samples]
    
    # calculate the median and sd of the counts
    # we have to make sure that we do this based on only the samples that had a 
    # nonzero count in the parent population (which is what we use the weights for)
    for (iSubset in 1:nrow(stats_) ) {
      study_idx = weights_study[iSubset, ] > 0
      
      counts_study_subset = as.numeric(counts_study[iSubset, study_idx])
      pctParent_study_subset = as.numeric(pctParent_study[iSubset, study_idx])
      
      stats_$medianCounts[iSubset] =   median(counts_study_subset)
      stats_$meanCounts[iSubset] =     mean(counts_study_subset)
      stats_$sdCounts[iSubset] =       sd(counts_study_subset)
      
      stats_$medianPctParent[iSubset] = median(pctParent_study_subset)
      stats_$meanPctParent[iSubset] =   mean(pctParent_study_subset)
      stats_$sdPctParent[iSubset] =     sd(pctParent_study_subset)
      
    }
    
    #merge into stats
    summaryStats = rbind(summaryStats, stats_)
    i = i + 1
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  }
  
  close(pb)
  
  summaryStats = dplyr::select(summaryStats, -studyGroup)
  
  stats = merge(stats, summaryStats, by = c("comparison", "subset"))
  
  stats = multipleTestCorrection(stats)
  
  # add AICs to stats
  stats$AIC = AICs[match(stats$subset, names(AICs))]
  
  
  return(stats)
}
```


```{r develop the analysis}

message("Starting analysis of ", str_replace_all(cellSubset, "_", "/"))

# Defaults -------------------------------------------------------------------
fdrCutoff = 0.05
pCutoff = 0.05 # for modifier analysis
medianCellCutoff = 10
analysis = "abTiter response"
  
# Set up directories ---------------------------------------------------------
statsDir =    file.path(resultsDir, "stats") # all the statistics before any level 1 or modifier analysis
level1Dir =   file.path(resultsDir, "level1")
modifierDir = file.path(resultsDir, "modifierAnalysis")
  
dir.create(statsDir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(level1Dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(modifierDir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
# Load and prep data ---------------------------------------------------------
filePath = file.path(dir_, paste0(cellSubset, ".Rdata") )

load(filePath)
  
pctParent = matrices[["pctParent"]]
popCounts = matrices[["popCounts"]]
parentCounts = matrices[["parentCounts"]]
  
nodes = matrices[["nodes"]]
design = matrices[["design"]]

design = dplyr::filter(design, !control)  
design$studyGroup = "DS"
design$studyGroup[design$patientType == "Control"] = "TC"
design$studyGroup = factor(design$studyGroup, levels = c("TC", "DS"))
design$sex = factor(design$sex, levels = sort(unique(design$sex)))
  
# add the abTiter and timePoint info
# design = merge(design, abTiterData, by = "khorLabId", all.x = T)
# design = merge(design, timePoints, by = "testId", all.x = T)
design$abTiter_T3 <- abTiterData$abTiter_T3[
  match(design$khorLabId, abTiterData$khorLabId)
]
design$timePoint   <- timePoints$timePoint[
  match(design$testId, timePoints$testId)
]
design <- design[!is.na(design$abTiter_T3), ]

design = dplyr::filter(design, !is.na(abTiter_T3) ) # remove samples with missing ab Titer info
# now subset your three matrices in one go:
if (!is.null(colnames(pctParent)) && length(colnames(pctParent))>0) {
  # subset by matching names
  keep_idx <- match(as.character(design$ALId), colnames(pctParent))
  if (anyNA(keep_idx)) {
    warning(
      "Dropping ", sum(is.na(keep_idx)),
      " design$ALId not found in pctParent colnames: ",
      paste(design$ALId[is.na(keep_idx)], collapse=", ")
    )
  }
  keep_idx <- keep_idx[!is.na(keep_idx)]
} else {
  # no column names: treat design$ALId as positions
  keep_idx <- as.integer(design$ALId)
  bad      <- keep_idx < 1 | keep_idx > ncol(pctParent)
  if (any(bad)) {
    warning(
      "Dropping ", sum(bad),
      " out‑of‑range ALId positions: ",
      paste(design$ALId[bad], collapse=", ")
    )
  }
  keep_idx <- keep_idx[!bad]
}

pctParent    <- pctParent[,    keep_idx, drop=FALSE]
popCounts    <- popCounts[,    keep_idx, drop=FALSE]
parentCounts <- parentCounts[, keep_idx, drop=FALSE]

# sanity check
message("Now have ", ncol(pctParent), " samples in pctParent & design: ",
        length(keep_idx), " rows in design")

table(design$timePoint, design$studyGroup)

# for now, subset to just the T3 timepoint
design_ = dplyr::filter(design, timePoint == "T3")
# 1) If ALId got turned into rownames, bring it back:
if (!"ALId" %in% colnames(design_)) {
  design_$ALId <- rownames(design_)
}
# 2) Drop any duplicated columns just in case:
design_ <- design_[ , !duplicated(colnames(design_))]


# global compartment analysis ------------------------------------------------
nodes_ = dplyr::filter(nodes, compartment == "global") # remove all nodes that are part of the rootpath

# only keep ALIds actually present in pctParent
valid_ALIDs <- intersect(design_$ALId, colnames(pctParent))
if (length(valid_ALIDs) < length(design_$ALId)) {
  warning(
    "Dropping ",
    length(design_$ALId) - length(valid_ALIDs),
    " samples not found in pctParent/popCounts matrix"
  )
}
pctParent_    <- pctParent[nodes_$subset,   valid_ALIDs, drop = FALSE]
popCounts_    <- popCounts[nodes_$subset,   valid_ALIDs, drop = FALSE]
parentCounts_ <- parentCounts[nodes_$subset, valid_ALIDs, drop = FALSE]

nodes_$subset = nodes_$pathInCompartment

rownames(pctParent_) = nodes_$subset
rownames(popCounts_) = nodes_$subset
rownames(parentCounts_) = nodes_$subset

models = runAbTiterModel(pctParent_, popCounts_, parentCounts_, design_, family = "gaussian", cutOff = medianCellCutoff)

stats = testVaxResponse(models, nodes_, design_, pctParent_, popCounts_, parentCounts_)

stats$timePoint = "T3"
stats$compartment = "global"

stats$comparison = paste0(stats$comparison, " at ", stats$timePoint, " in ", stats$compartment)

modifierAnalysis = modifierAnalysisAbTiter(stats, design_, pctParent_, parentCounts_, fdrCutoff = fdrCutoff, pCutoff = pCutoff)

modifierHits = modifierAnalysis$modifierHits
modifierResults = modifierAnalysis$modifierResults
modifierComparisons = modifierAnalysis$modifierComparisons

modifierHits$timePoint = "T3"
modifierHits$compartment = "global"


# antigen compartment analysis ------------------------------------------------
nodes_ = dplyr::filter(nodes, compartment == "antigen-specific") # remove all nodes that are part of the rootpath

pctParent_ = pctParent[nodes_$subset, design_$ALId]
popCounts_ = popCounts[nodes_$subset, design_$ALId]
parentCounts_ = parentCounts[nodes_$subset, design_$ALId]

nodes_$subset = nodes_$pathInCompartment

rownames(pctParent_) = nodes_$subset
rownames(popCounts_) = nodes_$subset
rownames(parentCounts_) = nodes_$subset

modelsAg = runAbTiterModel(pctParent_, popCounts_, parentCounts_, design_, family = "gaussian", cutOff = medianCellCutoff)

statsAg = testVaxResponse(modelsAg, nodes_, design_, pctParent_, popCounts_, parentCounts_)

statsAg$timePoint = "T3"
statsAg$compartment = "antigen-specific"

statsAg$comparison = paste0(statsAg$comparison, " at ", statsAg$timePoint, " in ", statsAg$compartment)

modifierAnalysisAg = modifierAnalysisAbTiter(statsAg, design_, pctParent_, parentCounts_, fdrCutoff = fdrCutoff, pCutoff = pCutoff)

modifierHitsAg = modifierAnalysisAg$modifierHits
modifierResultsAg = modifierAnalysisAg$modifierResults
modifierComparisonsAg = modifierAnalysisAg$modifierComparisons

modifierHitsAg$timePoint = "T3"
modifierHitsAg$compartment = "global"

stats = rbind(stats, statsAg)
modifierHits = rbind(modifierHits, modifierHitsAg)

save(stats, modifierHits, file = file.path(dataDir, paste0("flowBcell_abTiter_first_pass", ".Rdata")))

```




```{r this is part of the flow for cytyof}
# remove all the T2 and T3
design = dplyr::filter(design, timePoint == "T1")

table(design$ageAtDraw)

# matrices already had IC removed, but now I am just going to make sure they are in the same order
# and also remove unused timePoints
pctParent = pctParent[, design$ALId]
popCounts = popCounts[, design$ALId]
parentCounts = parentCounts[, design$ALId]

weights = parentCounts


nodes = dplyr::filter(nodes, !is.na(subset)) # remove all nodes that are part of the rootpath

# somehow "HLA-DR+/HLA-DR+ snuck into the data, we can just filter it out
nodes = dplyr::filter(nodes, str_count(pathInCompartment, "HLA\\-DR\\+") < 2)
pctParent = pctParent[nodes$subset, ]
popCounts = popCounts[nodes$subset, ]
weights = weights[nodes$subset, ]

subsets = nodes
  
# Run linear model -----------------------------------------------------------
models = runAbTiterModel(pctParent, popCounts, weights, design, family = "gaussian", cutOff = medianCellCutoff)
  
if (length(models) == 0) {
  message("No significant relatioships for AbTiter.")
  return(NULL)
}
  
# Create contrasts -----------------------------------------------------------
stats = testVaxResponse(models, subsets, design, pctParent, popCounts, weights)


level1Results = getLevel1(stats)


makeAbBoxplots(level1Results, pctParent, weights, design, models, colors)
  
# Save results to spreadsheets -----------------------------------------------
saveToSpreadsheet(stats, file.path(statsDir, paste0(cellSubset, "_stats.xlsx")))
saveToSpreadsheet(level1Results, file.path(level1Dir, paste0(cellSubset, "_level1.xlsx")))
  
# Run modifier analysis ------------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(dplyr::filter(stats, fdr < fdrCutoff)) == 0) {
  message("No significant results for ", cellSubset)
  return(NULL)
  }
  
modifierAnalysis = modifierAnalysisAbTiter(stats, design, pctParent, weights, fdrCutoff = fdrCutoff, pCutoff = pCutoff)
  

modifierHits = modifierAnalysis$modifierHits
modifierResults = modifierAnalysis$modifierResults
modifierComparisons = modifierAnalysis$modifierComparisons
  
  # Save modifier results to spreadsheet ---------------------------------------
saveModifierResultsToSpreadsheet(modifierHits, modifierResults, modifierComparisons, file.path(modifierDir, paste0(cellSubset, "_modifierAnalysis.xlsx")))
  
  results = list(models = models, stats = stats, modifierHits = modifierHits, modifierResults = modifierResults, modifierComparisons = modifierComparisons)
  dir.create(file.path("analysis_results", analysis), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  save(results, file = file.path("analysis_results", analysis, paste0(cellSubset, ".Rdata")))
  
  # Level 1 heatmap ------------------------------------------------------------
  hmtitle = paste0("Sig. level 1 of ", str_replace_all(cellSubset, "_", "/"))
  filePath = file.path(level1Plots, paste0("hm_", cellSubset, ".png"))
  
  # Make heatmap
  hm = makeHeatmap(level1Results, pctParent, design, colors, hmtitle, filePath = filePath)
  
  # Level 1 boxplots -----------------------------------------------------------
  # Regular 
  title = paste0("Level 1 of ", str_replace_all(cellSubset, "_", "/"))
  filePath = file.path(level1Plots, paste0("box_", cellSubset, ".png"))
  
  makeBoxplots(level1Results, pctParent, weights, design, colors, filePath = filePath, title = title, add_stats = F)
  
  # With stats
  title = paste0("Level 1 of ", str_replace_all(cellSubset, "_", "/"), " with significance indicator")
  filePath = file.path(level1Plots, paste0("box_", cellSubset, "_with_significance.png"))
  
  makeBoxplots(level1Results, pctParent, weights, design, colors, filePath = filePath, title = title, add_stats = T)
  
  # Modifier analysis heatmap --------------------------------------------------
  filePath = file.path(modifierPlots, paste0("hm_", cellSubset, ".png"))
  
  hmtitle = paste0("Modifier analysis results of ", str_replace_all(cellSubset, "_", "/"))
  
  hm = makeHeatmap(modifierResults, pctParent, design, colors, hmtitle, filePath = filePath)
  
  # Return ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  return(NULL)
  
}
```
